# About me

Julia Reinold is a postdoctoral researcher at Erasmus University Rotterdam, specialising in high-skilled migration. She is currently working on the Horizon Europe Project Link4Skills and responsible for the design, implementation and analysis of an online survey among high- and medium-skilled migrants in the Netherlands, Germany, Poland, Austria and Canada. Julia has experience conducting quantitative, qualitative, mixed methods and experimental research to better understand migration decision-making.

<BR>

<!-- # Expertise -->

```{r radarPlot, eval = FALSE}

member_name <- "Julia Reinold"
special_skill <- "science communication"

OS_skills <- read_csv(here("static/OS_skills.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(name %in% c("max", "min", member_name)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c("open source software", all_of(special_skill), "data sharing", "data management", "preregistration", "open access", "reproducible analysis"))

# custom radar plot
radarchart(OS_skills,
  axistype = 0, seg = 10,
  pcol = alpha("#002328", 0.8), pfcol = alpha("#00B969", 0.6), plwd = 4, centerzero = TRUE, # polygon
  cglcol = "#7e7e7e", axislabcol = "#002328", caxislabels = seq(0, 10, 2), cglwd = 0.8 # grid
)

```
